MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

6. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.

7. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

8. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

10. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
